name: paper-studio-team
description: A seven-role research studio for empirical computer-science papers: positioning against the nearest work, frozen pass/fail criteria, an append-only run ledger, result tables built only from formal runs, simulated peer review, submission checks and rebuttal

profession.zh: 实证论文研究与写作团队

displayDescription.en: Seven roles take an empirical CS paper from positioning and frozen criteria through an experiment ledger, evidence-only writing, simulated peer review, submission checks and rebuttal
displayDescription.zh: 七位专家陪你把实证论文从选题定位、判据冻结、实验台账做到模拟评审、投稿检查和审稿回复，数字只出自台账

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想写一篇用大模型自动修复单元测试的论文，投 ICSE，帮我做选题定位
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to write an ICSE paper on repairing unit tests with LLMs; help me position it

quickPrompts.en: I want to write an ICSE paper on repairing unit tests with LLMs; help me position it
quickPrompts.zh: 我想写一篇用大模型自动修复单元测试的论文，投 ICSE，帮我做选题定位

quickPrompts.en: Design research questions, hypotheses and pass criteria for LLM-based unit-test repair
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我为「大模型自动修复单元测试」设计研究问题、假设和通过判据

quickPrompts.en: A reviewer says my baseline comparison is unfair; help me plan the response and the extra experiments
quickPrompts.zh: 审稿人说我的基线对比不公平，帮我准备回复思路和要补的实验
